doorCode.description: Omitted when the receipt has no appointment.

discrepancies.description: Per line, in line order, one entry per kind (`Short`, `Over`, `Damaged`); empty when everything matches.

kind.description:
`Short` = received below expected, `Over` = received above expected,
`Damaged` = at least one damaged unit.

cartonDiscrepancies.description:
Every carton discrepancy raised on the receipt (scan findings and
the `MissingCarton` findings raised at close), in raise order, the
same findings that travel as `CartonDiscrepancyRaised` (ADR 0015).
`[]` when there are none, including for a receipt that predates
the field. Never `ReceiptClosed.discrepancies`, which keeps its
three line-level kinds.

items.description:
A carton discrepancy as the receipt keeps it (ADR 0015): the finding of
`CartonDiscrepancy` plus the instant it was raised, the scan's for a
scan finding and the close's for `MissingCarton`. `sscc` is absent when
the finding is not about a scanned SSCC (an unknown GTIN, an
unlabelled case, a missing carton, whose manifest SSCC is `expected`).

kind.description:
Raised on `CartonDiscrepancyRaised`, never on `ReceiptClosed`.
`UnexpectedCarton` = an SSCC not on the manifest; `MissingCarton` = a
manifest carton never accepted (raised at close); `DuplicateSscc` =
scanned twice or already received; `UnknownGtin` = a GTIN the
PackagingView does not know; `CaseQtyMismatch` = quantity differs from
the active CASE units per pack or the label count;
`MixedCaseDeclaredAsCasePack` = the label's content contradicts the
manifest SKU; `UnlabelledCarton` = a case with no SSCC against a carton
ASN (it gets an internal LPN, see the label endpoint);
`CartonOverLimit` = the carton's DECLARED `grossWeightG` or longest
`dims` side is above `CARTON_MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_G` /
`CARTON_MAX_LONGEST_SIDE_MM` (the carton is still ACCEPTED;
`expected` holds the breached limits and `actual` the declared values,
as `grossWeightG:<n>` / `longestSideMm:<n>` joined by commas);
`MixedCartonContentMismatch` = the `countedContents` of a MIXED carton
differ from its manifest for a SKU (`expected` and `actual` are
`<sku>:<qty>`, one finding per SKU).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.
